translations.web: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
translations.bsb: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.
translations.kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
translations.asv: and after the earthquake a fire; but Jehovah was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
